integrity: The proof uses a tame prime-to-three elliptic product decomposition and a geometric disjointness argument; finite computations are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Only the ordered normalized genus-five Humbert locus in characteristic three is classified; the parameter counts are not counts of unmarked curve isomorphism classes.
Historical priority may be affected by unindexed earlier work.
title: Disjoint supersingularity divisors on the characteristic-three Humbert locus
